title: AI now starts the shopping journey; our store must be ready for it
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Google launched Universal Cart in the US and Newegg added Google UCP checkout. Q3 PC shipments fell 22.4% (Gartner); Adobe forecasts $275.1B US online holiday sales.

points.headline: Google puts a cart inside Search and Gemini as retailers open agent checkout
points.detail: Google Universal Cart launched in the US, Newegg added Google UCP checkout, Amex built agent-purchase authorization. We should make our catalog and feeds agent-ready.

points.headline: AI is a mainstream discovery channel for holiday shoppers
points.detail: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Our product content must work for AI tools.

points.headline: PC volumes are falling sharply while prices climb
points.detail: Gartner reports Q3 shipments down 22.4% with higher ASPs; DigiTimes sees a 20%+ drop. We should plan pricing, promotions and stock for a smaller, costlier market.

points.headline: Online holiday demand is growing, and marketplace events set the pace
points.detail: Adobe forecasts $275.1B US online holiday sales; Prime Big Deal Days hit $9.86B with electronics up 85%. We should align PC deals to competitor sale windows.
